from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpense(BaseModel):
    """One company's operating and administrative expenses for a reporting period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company from the filing")
    expense_amount: str | None = Field(description="The expense amount as written in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the expense covers")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written (e.g. 'Operating expenses', 'Administration expenses')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the expense figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_expenses: list[CompanyExpense]
